# watchpoint_monitors (Data Source)

Lists the tenant's monitors (all types) as summaries, optionally filtered by type or status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every HTTP monitor for the tenant.
data "watchpoint_monitors" "http" {
  type = "HttpApi"
}

output "http_monitor_names" {
  value = [for m in data.watchpoint_monitors.http.monitors : m.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `status` (String) Optional monitor status filter (e.g. `Active`, `Paused`, `Maintenance`).
- `type` (String) Optional monitor type filter (e.g. `HttpApi`, `Ssl`, `Synthetic`, `Dns`, `Tcp`, `Ping`).

### Read-Only

- `monitors` (Attributes List) Matching monitor summaries. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monitors))

<a id="nestedatt--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `monitors`

Read-Only:

- `check_interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between checks.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Monitor ID.
- `last_check_at` (String) Timestamp of the last check (RFC 3339), if any.
- `last_check_status` (String) Result status of the last check, if any.
- `location_profile_name` (String) Location profile name, if assigned.
- `name` (String) Monitor name.
- `status` (String) Monitor status.
- `tags` (String) Comma-separated tags (CSV string).
- `target` (String) Monitored target (URL or host:port).
- `threshold_profile_name` (String) Threshold profile name, if assigned.
- `type` (String) Monitor type.
